# TimeZoneInfo v0.7.14 - Table of Contents

Time zone support for Elixir by using the IANA tz database.

## Pages

- [TimeZoneInfo](https://time-zone-info.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Config](https://time-zone-info.hexdocs.pm/config.md)
- [Changelog](https://time-zone-info.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [TimeZoneInfo](https://time-zone-info.hexdocs.pm/TimeZoneInfo.md): `TimeZoneInfo` provides a time zone database for
[Elixir](https://elixir-lang.org/) using the data from the
[the Internet Assigned Numbers Authority (IANA)](https://www.iana.org/time-zones).
- [TimeZoneInfo.TimeZoneDatabase](https://time-zone-info.hexdocs.pm/TimeZoneInfo.TimeZoneDatabase.md): Implementation of the `Calendar.TimeZoneDatabase` behaviour.

- Behaviours
  - [TimeZoneInfo.DataPersistence](https://time-zone-info.hexdocs.pm/TimeZoneInfo.DataPersistence.md): A behaviour to persist the data.

  - [TimeZoneInfo.DataStore](https://time-zone-info.hexdocs.pm/TimeZoneInfo.DataStore.md): A behaviour to store data and serve them later on.

  - [TimeZoneInfo.Downloader](https://time-zone-info.hexdocs.pm/TimeZoneInfo.Downloader.md): The behaviour for downloaders.

  - [TimeZoneInfo.Listener](https://time-zone-info.hexdocs.pm/TimeZoneInfo.Listener.md): A `behaviour` for `TimeZoneInfo` listeners.

- DataPersistence
  - [TimeZoneInfo.DataPersistence.FileSystem](https://time-zone-info.hexdocs.pm/TimeZoneInfo.DataPersistence.FileSystem.md): An implementation for the behaviour `TimeZoneInfo.DataPersistence` to persist
data in the file system.

  - [TimeZoneInfo.DataPersistence.Priv](https://time-zone-info.hexdocs.pm/TimeZoneInfo.DataPersistence.Priv.md): An implementation for the behaviour `TimeZoneInfo.DataPersistence` to persist
data in the `priv` dir.

- Downlaoder
  - [TimeZoneInfo.Downloader.Mint](https://time-zone-info.hexdocs.pm/TimeZoneInfo.Downloader.Mint.md): An implementation of the `TimeZoneInfo.Downloader` behaviour using `Mint`.

- Listener
  - [TimeZoneInfo.Listener.ErrorLogger](https://time-zone-info.hexdocs.pm/TimeZoneInfo.Listener.ErrorLogger.md): A listener to log `TimeZoneInfo` errors.
  - [TimeZoneInfo.Listener.Logger](https://time-zone-info.hexdocs.pm/TimeZoneInfo.Listener.Logger.md): A listener to log `TimeZoneInfo` events.

- Parser/Tranformer
  - [TimeZoneInfo.IanaParser](https://time-zone-info.hexdocs.pm/TimeZoneInfo.IanaParser.md): The IANA-Parser builds the data structure for `TimeZoneInfo`.
  - [TimeZoneInfo.Transformer](https://time-zone-info.hexdocs.pm/TimeZoneInfo.Transformer.md): The `Transformer` transfers the parsed IANA data into the required format for
`TimeZoneInfo`.

  - [TimeZoneInfo.Transformer.Abbr](https://time-zone-info.hexdocs.pm/TimeZoneInfo.Transformer.Abbr.md): This module provides some functions to create time zone abbreviations.

  - [TimeZoneInfo.Transformer.Rule](https://time-zone-info.hexdocs.pm/TimeZoneInfo.Transformer.Rule.md): This module handles and transforms the IANA rules.

  - [TimeZoneInfo.Transformer.RuleSet](https://time-zone-info.hexdocs.pm/TimeZoneInfo.Transformer.RuleSet.md): A rule set is a set of IANA rules with one entry per rule execution.

  - [TimeZoneInfo.Transformer.ZoneState](https://time-zone-info.hexdocs.pm/TimeZoneInfo.Transformer.ZoneState.md): The transformer for time-zones.
